policy.external_safety: external generated data is removed only at explicit known dataset paths or when containment under its authoritative output/generated/resource root is provable
policy.refresh_semantics: refresh is opt-in; reset alone remains purge-only. With --refresh-external, generated external datasets are transactionally staged and automatically restored if preparation fails.
